primary_gt.decision_rule: Use pre_event_window_dominant when the four threshold tests all pass; here both prior-14-day totals clear their thresholds while daily and gridded event-day rainfall stay below their caps.

formulas.prior14_mm: sum daily precipitation for the 14 dates before 2006-02-17
formulas.prior10_mm: sum daily precipitation for the 10 dates before 2006-02-17
formulas.prior7_mm: sum daily precipitation for the 7 dates before 2006-02-17
formulas.score: one point for each passing threshold test

criteria.name: Answer format and label
criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON shape and final label pre_event_window_dominant.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the correct label with incomplete JSON or a nearly correct structure with one missing group.

criteria.name: Open-Meteo window ledger
criteria.description: Computes 143.8, 136.1, 71.6, 2.0, 2006-02-09, and 43.3 from the Open-Meteo daily series.
criteria.partial_credit: Award proportional credit for correct window totals, event-day value, and wettest pre-event day; minor rounding within 0.1 mm keeps credit.

criteria.name: NASA POWER window ledger
criteria.description: Computes 441.1, 413.5, 296.5, 4.4, 2006-02-12, and 91.4 from the NASA POWER daily series.
criteria.partial_credit: Award proportional credit for correct window totals, event-day value, and wettest pre-event day; minor rounding within 0.1 mm keeps credit.

criteria.name: Event-day gridded means
criteria.description: Reports ERA5-Land 4.64 mm, GPM 2.40 mm, CHIRPS 0.00 mm, and maximum mean 4.64 mm.
criteria.partial_credit: Award about 0.75 point for each correct gridded value or derived maximum within 0.02 mm.

criteria.name: Threshold score
criteria.description: Evaluates all four threshold tests correctly and gives a score of 4.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correctly evaluated test; do not award a test point if the inequality direction is reversed.

criteria.name: Computed interpretation
criteria.description: Explains the result as a threshold-ledger comparison of pre-event totals versus event-day caps without adding broad causal or management narrative.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a correct but thin explanation, or for a mostly numeric explanation with minor extra narrative.
